name: Auto repair

pf.license.need: if: where the state registers repair shops, or certifies mechanics by repair kind
ask: The shop's repair-shop registration number, where the state has one
Each mechanic's certificate for the repair kinds they do, where the state certifies them
A tow driver's license, where the state's rules require one
pf.license.who: both: the shop, and each person
pf.license.check: the state's license lookup; where there's none, a person on Rosie's team checks within 1 business day
pf.license.blocks: nothing waits on a license (D96): the business and each person go live once set up and the owner says yes; a job the owner says needs a license they don't have isn't booked
pf.license.every_state: car A/C work only by a person with an EPA 609 certificate
pf.license.renewals: optional reminders the owner sets; a license the owner says has lapsed pauses that person's new bookings for that work (the owner's word, never a check)
pf.license.insurance: garage liability and coverage for customers' cars, as the business says; shown as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
pf.license.otherwise: identity checked, and 'license: what the business says'

pf.services.pattern: drop-off: the car is left at the shop and picked up when it's ready

list.name: Diagnosis (warning light, noise, how it drives)
list.price: one price, OK'd in writing on the drop-off page
list.length: a set time, like 1 hour; more time is new work that needs a new yes

list.name: Repair after a diagnosis
list.price: quoted at the visit: a written estimate with the most it can cost, signed before any repair
list.after: at the counter, or the bill Rosie texts with the ready text

list.name: Oil change, tire rotation, wiper blades, battery test
list.price: one price from the shop's board
list.length: 30 to 45 minutes; wait or drop off
list.place: at the shop; an oil change or battery can also be mobile

list.name: Scheduled maintenance by miles
list.price: one price per car, from the shop's list
list.length: about 2 to 3 hours, or the day

list.name: Safety inspection
list.price: one price; paid when booking, if the shop sets it

list.name: Tow-in
list.price: the tow's own price, plus the diagnosis
list.place: the car comes by tow at any time, keys in the key box

list.name: Mobile repair (brakes, battery, starter, a car that won't start)
list.price: one price, quoted from photos and the car's details, or quoted at the visit
list.place: at the customer's home or work

list.name: Pick-up and delivery
list.price: a flat fee, or free within a set distance
list.place: starts at the customer's door; the work is done at the shop

list.name: Pre-purchase inspection
list.place: at the shop, or where the car for sale is parked

pf.services.capacity: a daily cap on diagnoses (the example shop: 6 a day); one bay and one mechanic per job; the alignment rack and the loaner cars are saved like equipment
pf.services.drop_off_window: drop-off slots by the shop's daily number (the example shop: 6 cars a day), shown as drop-off times with no mechanic named, plus an after-hours key box once the drop-off page is signed
pf.services.loaners: a set number of loaner cars (the example shop: 2); the owner OKs each one; the driver is 21 or older, with license and insurance on the secure page
pf.services.shuttle: a free ride within a set distance and hours (the example shop: 5 miles, 8am to 5pm)
pf.services.warranty: on the receipt, in months or miles, parts and labor (the examples: 24 months or 24,000 miles at Lee's Garage; 12 months or 12,000 miles on Lee Mobile Auto's jobs)
pf.services.nobody_home: a mobile job on a parked car can be done with nobody there: the keys are left as agreed, and DONE comes with a photo

Any warning lights? Steady or flashing?
For a mobile job: where the car is parked, and whether it starts
after_time: Old parts back? Yes or no
Anything the mechanic should know, like when the noise happens
secure_page_only: For a loaner: the driver's license and insurance
Someone else who may say yes to the estimate, named in writing
pf.questions.who_may_book: an adult: the car's owner, or someone the owner lets bring it in; for a teen's car, a parent books and says yes to prices

stop_words: a fire, or flames from the engine
pf.safety.stop_action: 'Call 911' and the generic emergency steps; no booking
dont_drive_words: smoke or steam from under the hood
a wheel that shakes or wobbles
pf.safety.dont_drive_action: Rosie says: park somewhere safe, switch the engine off, and don't drive it. The booking can go on as a tow-in, or a mobile visit.
pf.safety.mobile_stops: a fuel leak, a car on a slope or a busy street, or no safe place to work: the mechanic stops, and the job moves to the shop

pf.first_steps.required: none before the visit; the diagnosis fee is OK'd in writing on the drop-off page when booking
at_check_in: A recall check on the VIN
The walk-around, the odometer and photos
prep_for_reminder: Bring the keys, and any wheel-lock key
The drop-off window, or the key box after hours
For a mobile job: park on flat ground with room to work, and leave the keys as agreed

pf.visit.check_in: a drop-off: the customer gives the check-in code at the counter when leaving the car. A key-box drop-off or a tow-in has no code: the mechanic texts IN once the car and keys are found. Mobile: the code at the car, as at any door.
pf.visit.intake: the odometer, the keys, a walk-around with photos, the problem in the customer's words, old parts back or not; a loaner signed out
pf.visit.recall_check: the VIN is checked for open safety recalls at check-in; an open recall is told to the customer, and its fix is free at the carmaker's dealers
pf.visit.diagnosis: the OK'd fee covers a set time; more time is new work that needs a new yes; no answer is never a yes
pf.visit.estimate: written, with parts and labor lines, new or used, carmaker or aftermarket parts, and the most it can cost; signed before any repair
pf.visit.added_work: anything over the signed estimate needs a new yes before it's done, logged with the time, the phone and the new total
pf.visit.ready: READY texts the customer the total, the pick-up hours and any storage terms
pf.visit.pick_up: the car goes only to the customer, or someone they name; the work and any old parts are shown; a loaner comes back with its miles and fuel noted
pf.visit.done_proof: the drop-off code, or IN, checks the car in; READY and the pick-up close it
pf.visit.late_drop_off: the shop's rule: diagnosed the same day if there's room, or else the next day
pf.visit.pick_up_and_delivery: the driver gets the code at the door with the keys; the car is fixed at the shop and brought back on a booked return

pf.money.before: the starting answer is nothing taken; the diagnosis fee is OK'd in writing, not charged
pf.money.after: paid at the counter at pick-up, the shop's own way; or the bill Rosie texts with the ready text, if the owner turns it on
pf.money.mobile: the trip fee held; the bill after DONE, or the saved card
pf.money.deposit: a parts deposit only on a price set before the visit; deposit cap: from the state form
pf.money.storage: a daily storage fee only after the free working days that follow the ready text, told before drop-off, and only once the owner confirms it; storage limits: from the state form
pf.money.after_a_no: after a no to the estimate, only the OK'd diagnosis, plus any putting-back-together the state's rules allow
pf.money.fees: no cancel or no-show fee to start; the owner can turn one on for long jobs
pf.money.tax: the shop's tax rate on parts and labor

pf.messages.minors: texts about a teen's car go to the parent who booked

pf.staff.licenses: each mechanic's certificate per repair kind, where the state certifies them; an EPA 609 certificate for car A/C work, in every state; a tow driver's license where the state's rules require it
pf.staff.supervision: an apprentice works only while a certified mechanic who may supervise them is on, where the state's rules require it
pf.staff.who_oks: the owner or the service writer OKs estimates, added work, loaners and storage fees
pf.staff.stand_in: only someone certified for that repair kind

pf.rules.written_estimate: switch: a written estimate before work, above an amount: from the state form
pf.rules.written_ok_for_diagnosis: switch: a written OK for the diagnosis fee: from the state form
pf.rules.overage: Rosie's rule: never over the signed estimate without a new yes; no state leeway is used
pf.rules.choose_any_shop: switch: a line saying the customer may pick any shop: from the state form
pf.rules.old_parts: switch: offer the old parts back: from the state form; warranty or core-exchange parts are shown, not given
pf.rules.show_number: switch: the shop's state number on estimates and receipts: from the state form
pf.rules.work_order: switch: what the work order must carry, like the odometer and the problem in the customer's words: from the state form
pf.rules.storage_notice: switch: storage terms told before drop-off, and the free days: from the state form
pf.rules.unclaimed_car: switch: the state's garage-lien and abandoned-car steps; the owner runs them, and Rosie sends only the notices the owner OKs
pf.rules.recalls: the carmaker's dealers fix open recalls for free; the shop tells the customer and doesn't do the recall work itself

applies: A no-show at drop-off: no fee to start
The car gets worse before drop-off: the don't-drive steps, then a tow-in
The car isn't picked up: storage, then written notice
A loaner back late or damaged
The problem comes back under warranty
pf.edges.handling: each the generic way, with the plug-in's words; the owner confirms every fee

A.other: Others (a bank, a parent, the carmaker's dealer)

story.A: Sam Lee signs up two companies by text. Then Alex books an 11:00am drop-off slot at Lee's Garage for a car with a check-engine light, Sat Oct 24. Andre diagnoses it, and the repair is done only once Alex signs the written estimate. Pick a money choice at the top to follow its path.
story.B: Sam Lee signs up two companies by text. Then Alex books Lee Mobile Auto to fix the car at home, at 17 Birch Ln, and Luis comes Thu Oct 22 between 8 and 10am. The job depends on the money choice you pick: front brake pads, a coolant leak, or a new radiator.
